skill_name: Summarize the differences between a debit and credit card
workflow: Debit and credit cards are both payment methods with many similarities, but there are important differences between the two. Debit cards are linked to a checking account and allow you to make payments directly from your account balance. Credit cards, on the other hand, allow you to borrow money up to an established credit limit and pay it off in installments.
